barnard_manifest.json is the real manifest of sequence 9e2430a33e56af09 (Barnard's Star field, 6 arcmin),
trimmed to the twelve exposures whose cutouts are recorded in tests/fixtures/cutouts (detectors 2 and 6,
three epochs). Nothing in it was edited except the removal of the other frames and the matching counts.
uri_map.json lists the IRSA path of each obs_id (the notebook cache format); gaia is tests/fixtures/gaia/barnard_mast.xml.
